theorem_statement: For the complex Deligne-Mumford stack of stable genus-six curves with six ordered markings and rational coefficients, H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8), with rank zero allowed. Equivalently, if b_16 is its rational dimension, then H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is isomorphic to Q(-8)^{oplus b_16} as a polarizable rational Hodge structure. No integral, coarse-moduli, algebraic-generation, tautological-generation, or Betti-number formula is asserted.
summary: The right-exact boundary sequence has boundary image equal to the kernel of the compact-to-open map. ATT-0146 makes that image a finite Q(8)-sum and ATT-0136 makes the open Borel-Moore quotient a finite Q(8)-sum. Smooth proper purity and semisimplicity split the resulting short exact sequence, so compact homology in degree sixteen is a finite Q(8)-sum. Proper rational duality gives the asserted Q(-8)-type for compact cohomology in the same degree.

claims.statement: The exact open quotient W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), with rank zero allowed.
claims.justification: This is exactly ATT-0136, independently confirmed by REV-0187 and REV-0188, and is the theorem targeted by Lean campaign LC66-002.

claims.statement: The image of H_{16}(hat{partial}Mbar_{6,6};Q) in H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), with rank zero allowed, and the proper pushforward has no Gysin degree shift or extra Tate twist.
claims.justification: This is exactly ATT-0146, independently confirmed by REV-0199 and REV-0200.

claims.statement: Specializing THM-0003 to (g,n,k)=(6,6,16), right exactness gives a short exact sequence 0 -> im(nu_*) -> H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) -> W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) -> 0 in rational mixed Hodge structures; the boundary image is the kernel and the open term is the quotient.
claims.justification: Exactness at compact homology identifies the kernel with the image, and right exactness makes the compact-to-open map surjective. No regular-embedding or cohomological Gysin reinterpretation is used.

claims.statement: H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is a pure polarizable rational Hodge structure of weight -16.
claims.justification: Mbar_{6,6} is a smooth proper complex Deligne-Mumford stack, so H^{16} is pure polarizable of weight 16 by THM-0001, and rational Hodge duality gives the stated homological form.

claims.statement: A short exact sequence whose subobject and quotient are finite direct sums of Q(8), and whose middle object is pure polarizable of weight -16, has middle object isomorphic to a finite direct sum of Q(8). Applied to CLM-0147-1 through CLM-0147-4, H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8).
claims.justification: Polarizable pure rational Hodge structures of fixed weight are semisimple (FND-0033); the extension splits, and direct sums add.

claims.statement: Proper rational homology-cohomology duality identifies H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) with H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q)^vee, with no degree shift. Dualizing Q(8) gives Q(-8), hence the whole compact cohomology group H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8), with unspecified finite rank and rank zero allowed.
claims.justification: For a proper complex Deligne-Mumford stack, ordinary homology is the rational Hodge dual of ordinary cohomology in the same degree. This is not the dimension-21 Poincare-duality formula used for the open Borel-Moore term.

failed_approaches_addressed: Do not replace proper same-degree duality by the open dimension-21 Borel-Moore Poincare twist.
Do not insert a codimension-one Gysin shift into the finite boundary pushforward.
Do not identify the boundary source with its image or the open quotient with the compact middle object.
Do not infer algebraic or tautological generation from Hodge-Tate type.
